meta.name: ZILFIT Emotional Recipe — Edition × Comfort Mapping
meta.boundary: Engineering simulation input only. No medical, diagnostic, therapeutic, or treatment claims. All language follows z_claims_scanner.py safe-wording policy.

CALM.intended_effect: Support gentle sensory grounding and soft plantar stimulation for comfort-oriented rest periods.

first_sensation_20min.primary: Gentle pressure release across midfoot contact zone
first_sensation_20min.secondary: Reduced perceived heaviness in arch area

cumulative_effect.description: Repeated use may support sustained sensory calm through consistent low-pressure stimulation patterns during stationary wear.
cumulative_effect.measurement: Comfort score delta from baseline Z-Bio scoring

stimulation_profile.description: Wide, slow pressure modulation focused on midfoot with minimal forefoot stimulation. Designed for stationary comfort.

safety_flags: Not intended for post-athletic recovery use alone — combine with VITAL if fatigue >= 6/10
Lower density limits load-bearing capacity — Z-Physics must verify under 80 kg+ scenarios

VITAL.intended_effect: Support post-exertion recovery experience through zone-specific plantar pressure relief and targeted stimulation of high-load foot areas.

first_sensation_20min.primary: Relief sensation in heel strike zone through reduced peak pressure
first_sensation_20min.secondary: Arch decompression feeling during midfoot transition
first_sensation_20min.tertiary: Forefoot release from repeated push-off load

cumulative_effect.description: Repeated post-exertion sessions may support faster perceived recovery through consistent pressure redistribution across heel, arch, and forefoot zones.
cumulative_effect.measurement: Z-Bio comfort score trend + pressure delta from activity baseline

stimulation_profile.description: Zone-specific pressure relief with concave heel basin, arched midfoot bridge, and linear forefoot channels. Higher stimulation than CALM, focused on recovery geometry.

safety_flags: Z-Sim must validate heel basin depth against TPU wall collapse risk at 110+ kg
Not a replacement for professional post-injury care — BLOCK if acute injury detected

FOCUS.intended_effect: Support alertness and sensory clarity through targeted hallux and forefoot stimulation with responsive, light-contact geometry.

first_sensation_20min.primary: Light hallux stimulation creating clear toe contact awareness
first_sensation_20min.secondary: Responsive forefoot feel under weight shift

cumulative_effect.description: Repeated use may support sustained sensory awareness through consistent light forefoot and hallux zone stimulation during active wear.
cumulative_effect.measurement: Z-Bio forefoot comfort score + toe zone pressure consistency

stimulation_profile.description: Focused, higher-amplitude stimulation at hallux and forefoot with firm heel base. Smaller contact area than VITAL but sharper pressure peaks for sensory clarity.

safety_flags: Higher forefoot density may feel firm for users with thin forefoot pads — Z-Bio must flag if comfort score < 0.6
Not intended for post-exertion recovery — redirect to VITAL if fatigue >= 6/10

BALANCE.intended_effect: Support stability and even pressure distribution through symmetric density mapping and wider support footprint geometry.

first_sensation_20min.primary: Even weight feel across heel-through-toe contact line

cumulative_effect.description: Repeated use during standing or walking may support improved perceived balance through symmetric pressure distribution and wider contact zone mapping.
cumulative_effect.measurement: Left-right pressure delta + Z-Bio balance score

stimulation_profile.description: Uniform density plateau across all zones with emphasis on coverage breadth (90%). Designed for stability, not stimulation. Lowest stimulation intensity among all editions.

safety_flags: Uniform 0.50 density is highest in system — Z-Physics must verify TPU does not feel rigid below 80 kg
If left-right delta > 30 kPa persists after 3 sessions, escalate to agent review

FEMME.intended_effect: Support female-specific biomechanical comfort through narrower heel containment, wider forefoot accommodation, and softer sensory stimulation mapped to female gait patterns.

first_sensation_20min.primary: Soft heel containment with reduced edge pressure

cumulative_effect.description: Repeated wear may support sustained female-specific comfort through consistent mapping of pelvis/Q-angle-informed geometry to plantar pressure distribution.
cumulative_effect.measurement: Z-Bio femme comfort score + forefoot pressure uniformity index

stimulation_profile.description: Asymmetric density profile optimized for female gait (narrower heel, wider forefoot). Softer stimulation than VITAL but broader than CALM. Can layer CALM or BALANCE as secondary.

compatibility_layer.description: FEMME can combine with any other edition as secondary. The secondary edition modifies density_map by weighted average (FEMME 60% + secondary 40%).

safety_flags: Heel containment must not create edge pressure > 200 kPa at 80 kg
If user reports forefoot pinching, reduce forefoot density by 0.03 and re-run simulation
Not intended for post-injury use — BLOCK if acute pelvic or hip injury detected

primary_secondary_layering.description: When two editions are selected (e.g., FEMME + VITAL), blend density maps at the zone level. Primary edition = 60%, secondary = 40%.
primary_secondary_layering.stimulation_blend: Use the HIGHER intensity profile between the two editions.

comfort_threshold.action_below_threshold: Reject edition — escalate to Z-Sim and Z-Claims for review.

edition_switching.description: Edition can be re-selected per session. No cumulative tracking across editions — each session resets to edition-specific baseline.
